definition: an injection that protects you from a disease
description: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.
transcript: Tiny pitch. Done. Ow, not bad. Brave. Yay!

taps.target: the woman in the grey top
